principle: An idea should become agentic only when sensing, memory, tools, routines, approvals, evals, or learning loops create real user value beyond simple generation.

maturity_levels.name: Normal App
maturity_levels.description: Deterministic product with no AI core loop.

maturity_levels.name: AI Generation
maturity_levels.description: User prompts the model and receives generated output.
avoid: claiming automation without memory or tools

maturity_levels.name: AI Plus Tools
maturity_levels.description: AI uses tools to retrieve data or create artifacts inside a user-driven task.

maturity_levels.name: Memory-Backed Copilot
maturity_levels.description: The system uses durable private context to improve recommendations and outputs.

maturity_levels.name: Workflow Agent With Approvals
maturity_levels.description: The system runs multi-step workflows and asks for approval at defined gates.

maturity_levels.name: Bounded Autonomous Operator
maturity_levels.description: The system runs recurring or event-triggered work within strict permissions and policies.

maturity_levels.name: Domain Operating System
maturity_levels.description: The product becomes the user's operating layer for a domain with memory, tools, routines, evals, and learning.
avoid: building the full OS before proving the first closed loop

dimensions.name: Sensing and Inputs
questions: What must the system see, read, hear, watch, ingest, or monitor?
Are inputs manual, connected, scheduled, event-driven, or external?

dimensions.name: Memory and Knowledge Base
questions: What examples, proofs, preferences, stories, assets, or outcomes make future work better?

dimensions.name: Creation and Transformation
questions: What artifacts should the system create?
What quality bar and evals are required?

dimensions.name: Action and Tool Use
questions: What external systems should it act inside?
Which actions are read-only, write, paid, destructive, public, or externally visible?

dimensions.name: Human Approval and Control
questions: What are stop buttons, rollback paths, and escalation rules?

dimensions.name: Evaluation and Quality
questions: How do we know outputs are good?
What scorecards or golden examples are needed?

domain_patterns.name: Social Content Operating System
domain_patterns.first_closed_loop: capture proof/story -> update voice/proof memory -> generate weekly content brief -> approve direction -> draft platform post -> score voice/proof/platform fit

domain_patterns.name: Research Intelligence Engine
domain_patterns.first_closed_loop: collect sources -> score evidence -> synthesize brief -> audit quality -> approve publication candidate -> update research memory

domain_patterns.name: Customer Operations Agent
domain_patterns.first_closed_loop: ingest customer message -> classify intent/risk -> draft response/action -> approve send/update -> track outcome

domain_patterns.name: Creative Media Agent
domain_patterns.first_closed_loop: capture creative brief -> generate concept variants -> review/select -> render asset -> quality check -> store approved asset
